EUR.catalyst: The euro trades near multi-week lows against the dollar, holding below its 20-day (1.1616), 50-day (1.1538), and 200-day (1.1635) moving averages as macroeconomic risks weigh on the currency. 📉 Raise rates too quickly, and the yen carry trade could unwind as borrowing costs rise, potentially sending volatility across global markets.

The next major catalyst: the Bank of Japan meeting on September 17–18. Traders will be watching closely for clues on rates, intervention, and the future direction of the yen.
